a note, written simply

A letter from the little courier.

A little letter, just for you

A Little Apology ❤️

I'm truly sorry.

Last night, you wanted me to stay a little longer and listen to you. I was getting sleepy, but I never wanted you to feel that you weren't important to me.

I genuinely love listening to your stories, your voice notes, and all those little things you share with me. And if any of my silly jokes hurt you, please forgive me. I never meant to upset you.

I know beautiful words mean nothing without genuine feelings. I promise to be more understanding, listen better, and respect your feelings.

I'm not asking you to forgive me immediately. I just wanted you to know that you matter to me more than my careless words sometimes show.

With love,
Your Buddhu ❤️

No reply is expected. Take your time, and take care.
